answer: Make every agent earn its place slowly. A new identity starts with an empty vault and no credit, so it can only take small unpaid jobs. Each finished job adds one verified line to a public record. That record reads like a sonnet, fixed in form, so nothing can hide inside it, and faking it takes as much work as doing it for real. Only when the record is full does the harbor open, the shared pool of paid work. Cloning a thousand fresh identities buys nothing, because each one still has to write its own sonnet from scratch.
